title: Adelia & Hope
dek: A shadow sorceress whose history includes Jiangshi’s loss and return, mercy toward Magnus, and her own sacrifice for Hope and Gael.
imageAlt: Adelia hooded in black beneath a pale moon, holding a staff

facts.Transformation: Voluntary sacrifice for Hope · 2026, exact date unresolved
facts.Later names: Spirit of Adelia · Empyrean · Life Knight

sources: gael-codex-emphasis-corrections.md · reconciled with selected Gael RP scenes, 12 October 2026
body:
Adelia’s history begins long before she becomes bound to Hope. A shadow sorceress remembered in Pristinia, a partner grieving Jiangshi, and an adventurer helping life take root in Gael, she repeatedly refuses to let loss have the final word. That refusal gives Magnus another chance—and leaves her facing the harm he chooses to do with it.

March 2024 · curiosity before the title

In the opening expedition, Adelia announces her willingness to fight, records what she sees, takes a sample of unfamiliar growth and tells Scribonia that her interests include flora and fauna. Observation and inquiry belong to her history before the Shadow Sentinel chronicle and long before her transformation.

These actions do not establish that she correctly identifies every substance she encounters. They show a habit of looking closely and trying to learn, beside the confidence of her public challenges.

The Shadow Sentinel

By April 2024, Ada’s public chronicle, The Shadow Sentinel: Chronicles of Adelia the Sorceress, connects Adelia with shadows, magical power, crossbow combat, Alyhotep, Jiangshi, grief and resistance to death. Love confronting mortality is already part of her public identity. Her later attachment to Hope grows from that earlier life rather than replacing it.

March 2024 · a person beyond service

In an early forest conversation, Jiangshi explains the discipline through which she understands service and survival. Adelia insists that Jiangshi’s own needs and wishes matter as well. She offers comfort; Jiangshi answers that the discipline itself helps keep her steady. The exchange preserves two ways of understanding care rather than turning one speaker’s advice into a complete explanation of the other.

Their later partnership grows from such encounters. Adelia’s wish to protect someone is already accompanied by the harder work of listening to what that person says she needs. This conversation supplies no wedding date or universal account of Jiangshi’s condition.

Jiangshi: intervention and presence

Adelia and Jiangshi share a deep romantic partnership. Their ways of caring differ: Adelia often acts to prevent loss, while Jiangshi remains beside someone without demanding that they speak or decide. Jiangshi’s quiet care gives Adelia somewhere to be vulnerable without having to solve everything first.

Jiangshi’s loss belongs to the June 2024 Gael and Void history; the exact day remains uncertain. Adelia and Bitoshi blame Nienna’s retreat, while Gartina argues that returning would likely have caused another unrecoverable death. For Adelia, survival can become inseparable from the painful question of whether more could have been done.

The July coffin landing, Moirah’s August recovery of Jiangshi’s body, and the prolonged absence described in Jiangshi’s later history remain distinct episodes. They do not establish a complete death-and-return sequence. Later continuity treats the pair as married, but their wedding date and ceremony remain unknown.

A living foothold before the transformation

In August 2024, Adelia and Elenia help establish or prove an early living foothold in Gael. Gartina is already asking how restoration can be sustained. By September, Hope has grown into a recognizable glowing tree; the Hallowing gathers a larger company, and Nienna gives her life so the work can finish.

Adelia mourns Nienna and continues caring for Hope as a living presence. Refugees, settlers, research and practical rebuilding follow. Her later transformation does not begin Gael’s restoration, and the abundance that follows it does not erase the work of Elenia, Gartina, Dale, Nienna, Hope and the wider community.

Nienna’s sacrifice and Adelia’s later choice both raise the question of who chooses the cost. Their histories have a thematic connection; Adelia’s act is not established as an imitation of Nienna’s.

Follow Gael’s shared restoration history →

August 2024 · freeing Hope at a cost

The quest posted on 5 August locally, continuing into 6 August UTC, finds the earlier golden tree darkened by a consuming shadow. Elenia’s Daylight makes it recoil; Dale’s Dispel Magic makes it lurch. Neither frees the tree. Wren hears its need for more light while companions watch for the approaching enemy and Gartina works to cleanse the ground.

Adelia tries her shadow-clipping scissors. Warned that the attempt will put her at great risk, she continues and places herself between the tree and her companions. The shadow is severed in a violent blast that injures people nearby. A transformed, luminous tree remains, spreading life through the ground.

The narrator cannot tell the company whether the shadow was destroyed or driven away. The scene establishes an intervention and its immediate cost, not a permanent end to every threat. It also places this stage of Hope’s renewal before September’s Hallowing and Adelia’s much later transformation.

Faith, trust and political judgment

Adelia’s mortal life includes political choices as well as miracles. Aria publicly challenges her over resurrection, divine power and what the watching crowd believes. Adelia later supports Magnus in Zarathian politics. Her trust in him belongs to a relationship with a person, not foreknowledge of his eventual betrayal.

In post-Aria proceedings involving Elenia, Adelia understands some of her motivations but objects strongly to divine power being used for attempted murder. Consent, trust and the means of protection matter to her. That judgment also raises a standard for her own growing power: a good purpose does not settle whether a method is justified.

27 February 2026: a second chance

Adelia returns to Hope with Jiangshi and Bitoshi. The reunion begins with affection: Adelia smiles at the tree, and Jiangshi affirms the bonds that have survived desolation.

“even in the desolation… Hope prevails… just like Love… and the Faith i have in you two”
Jiangshi

Adelia calls Magnus her friend and asks that he be returned. Through Divine Intervention, she invokes Moirah, Cala, Nuru and Hope. Magnus returns in a fresh body. For Adelia, death need not be the final answer while another choice remains possible.

Moirah appears furious. She says Magnus’s soul belongs to Death and describes retrieving it from his possession while he laughed. The rebuke reveals a cost and metaphysical claim that Adelia’s mercy did not fully control.

Mercy betrayed

Dumuzi offers Magnus a gift, which he accepts before learning its nature: a special Power Word Kill capable of harming the Tree Shards. Magnus turns it against Hope.

“Hope is dead. Only Ambition remains.”
Magnus Niriin

Hope begins to wither and Magnus flees. Adelia immediately tries to save the tree and declares her intention to kill him. Rage gives way to self-blame. Her resurrection made his new choice possible; his betrayal remains his own act.

Jiangshi helps and comforts her, while Bitoshi and Alyhotep remain. Magnus’s declaration does not describe everything left behind: care continues in the very place he has wounded.

Read the Withering of Hope →

Giving herself for Hope

Later in 2026, Adelia voluntarily gives up her former existence to restore or save Hope. The exact date, full sequence and mechanism remain unresolved. She becomes deeply bound to Hope and Gael, known through the names Spirit of Adelia, Empyrean and Life Knight, alongside demigod and Tree imagery. These names do not establish one complete account of her divine nature.

Abundant life spreads through Gael afterward. Adelia becomes bound to the land she spent years helping to preserve, deepening the relationship with living Gael that began during her life as an adventurer.

The Rift: protection after transformation

In later Rift history, Pappy is ambushed. Adelia becomes aware of the threat and Gates him out. The rescue shows that her transformed existence still includes perception, judgment and active protection.

The exact scope of that awareness and the limits of her intervention remain unsettled. Disputes about player consent, knowledge and moderation are separate from the witnessed rescue; they do not provide a settled account of Adelia’s character or unrestricted powers.

September 2026 · a letter and an invitation

On the coast before the departure for Verdelune, Adelia waits for Oya and gives her a sealed letter from Nymera. Oya regrets missing her friend. Adelia then invites her to visit the tree when she returns.

Adelia carries another person’s words and offers Oya a place to return to, alongside the extraordinary powers now associated with her. The sealed letter’s contents are not disclosed, and the invitation does not prove that the later visit happened.

Care and authority

Adelia’s loyalty, willingness to pay a personal cost and belief in second chances repeatedly preserve people and places. Her danger lies in over-responsibility: blaming herself for another person’s choices, or allowing the ability to prevent loss to become a claim to decide for others.

Jiangshi and Magnus leave different experiences of trust. Jiangshi stays when Adelia is vulnerable; Magnus uses her mercy to wound what she loves. Betrayal may tempt a protector to control more, but Adelia has not declared that as her doctrine. Her continuing question is how to protect what she loves without making love into ownership.

The people and places around her

  • Jiangshi: love, loss, return and care that makes room for vulnerability.
  • Hope and Gael: a living project that becomes inseparable from her identity.
  • Nienna: grief, the Hallowing and a chosen sacrifice carried forward in memory.
  • Magnus: friendship, a second chance, betrayal and the danger of self-blame.
  • Elenia: early restoration, shared power and judgments that do not always agree.
  • Pappy: a later rescue that makes the boundaries of protection consequential.
  • Gartina and Dale: fellow contributors to the communal work of making Gael livable.

What remains unresolved

The wedding chronology, Adelia’s transformation date and full mechanics, the precise nature of her new existence, and the limits of her awareness and Gate remain open. Gael’s ongoing renewal combines her changed presence with earlier and continuing communal work; every later phenomenon cannot be assigned to her alone.

Faith and belonging in Fein Uaill

At the castle, Adelia says she feels unwelcome and cut off from Moirah. Elenia and Olokun urge discretion about divine worship; Adelia refuses to deny her beliefs. Her feeling of exclusion does not establish confinement or a blanket ban on travel. She wants to reunite the islands and proposes calling a ferryman, but acknowledges uncertainty over the route and safety. The January conversation ends with her preparing a plan, rather than a witnessed crossing or permanent ferry service.

Hope carried by the community

Jiangshi calls Adelia the true Hope of Gael in a December 2024 exchange. Adelia widens the claim: hope is neither a tree nor a single person, but every one of them. That answer belongs beside her later transformation. Becoming inseparable from sacred life does not erase the relationships, care and shared work that gave it meaning.

In July 2026, Jiangshi resets their recall sanctuary, Bitoshi helps with the area, and the company discusses future buildings, prayer and meditation near the Tree. Adelia requires review of building plans. The scene preserves sanctuary work and proposals, rather than a finished temple or universal authority over Gael.

A bridge to companions in Babel

Adelia visits Nymera at Skylight Refuge in a projected form. Nymera first asks whether Oya is safe, then warns how dangerous Babel has been. Adelia says Ryvyt has already been warned; she later sends him through a Gate. The exchange connects her work around Hope to friends elsewhere without establishing that she can protect them from every risk.

After the expedition, Adelia visits the exhausted company again and brings Ryvyt back to Gael. His departure and return are witnessed travel. They do not demonstrate that the mist has been solved or that the divine meeting discussed at the Refuge has occurred.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-03-05 · quest

    Curiosity before the Shadow Sentinel

    Adelia records unfamiliar growth, takes a sample and describes her interest in flora and fauna.

    Known at this stage
    She is observing an unfamiliar world rather than already understanding it.
    Consequence
    Inquiry accompanies her willingness to fight.
    Still unresolved
    The sample is not independently identified by her interest in it.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  2. 2024-03-11 · compatible RP

    Care leaves room for the other person’s answer

    Adelia tells Jiangshi that her own needs and wishes matter; Jiangshi explains why discipline and service sustain her.

    Known at this stage
    They offer different accounts of what care requires.
    Consequence
    Their relationship begins through conversation as well as protection.
    Still unresolved
    The exchange does not date their marriage or settle Jiangshi’s whole condition.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

  3. 2024-07-19 · quest

    Protection before the confrontation

    Adelia casts Death Ward on herself, Bitoshi and Elenia before the expedition continues.

    Known at this stage
    The company prepares for danger rather than knowing the outcome.
    Consequence
    Her work is protective before later accounts attach larger meanings to Hope.
    Still unresolved
    These targets are not an exclusive list of everyone protecting the party.

    Receipt 1

  4. 2024-08-06 · quest

    A consuming shadow is severed

    After other remedies fail to free Hope, Adelia severs the attached shadow; the blast injures nearby companions and a luminous tree remains.

    Known at this stage
    The narrator warns her of the risk; the enemy is approaching.
    Consequence
    Hope’s restoration includes a dangerous August intervention before the Hallowing.
    Still unresolved
    The company cannot distinguish destruction of the shadow from its being driven away.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6 · Receipt 7 · Receipt 8

  5. 2024-09-06 · quest

    The labor of the Hallowing

    The narrator records the spell’s completion and names Adelia, Gartina and Elenia among those exhausted by sustaining it.

    Known at this stage
    The participants have endured the casting and defense, not received a guarantee of later safety.
    Consequence
    Gael’s living ground has a collective history of labor and cost.
    Still unresolved
    The scene does not assign the entire restoration to one person.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  6. 2024-12-27 · compatible RP

    Answering Jiangshi’s praise

    Jiangshi calls Adelia the true Hope in her eyes. Adelia answers that hope belongs to everyone.

    Known at this stage
    These are two speakers’ interpretations of what they have survived together.
    Consequence
    Adelia’s answer resists a history that reduces the community to its strongest figure.
    Still unresolved
    Later transformation does not retroactively turn either statement into exclusive authorship.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  7. 2026-09-08 · quest

    Carrying a friend’s words

    Adelia gives Oya Nymera’s sealed letter and invites her to visit the tree.

    Known at this stage
    Oya has missed the chance to say goodbye.
    Consequence
    Transformed existence still includes personal errands and hospitality.
    Still unresolved
    The letter’s contents and a completed later visit are not shown.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

nodes.title: Jiangshi
nodes.subtitle: Loss, return, and chosen presence
nodes.relation: Fear shaped by having already lost one another
nodes.history: Jiangshi’s death in Gael continues altering Adelia during the seven and a half months of absence. After returning, Jiangshi’s fear of losing Adelia is rooted in a world that already continued without her once.
nodes.consequence: Their bond gives Adelia’s later transformation a human scale. Becoming part of Hope does not erase the person Jiangshi is afraid to lose.
nodes.evidence: Loss, return, and mutual importance are established; the full intimate chronology remains incomplete.

nodes.title: Hope
nodes.subtitle: Living legacy and transformed existence
nodes.history: Adelia’s affection for Hope begins before ascension. After Magnus wounds the Tree Shard, Adelia gives herself to restore and save Hope, becoming more deeply bound to the life she protected.
nodes.consequence: The sacrifice creates the Spirit of Adelia state and expands her protective power, while making ordinary boundaries and consent harder to separate from the being she has become.
nodes.evidence: Sacrifice and Tree-linked transformation are established; exact mechanics and date remain incomplete.

nodes.title: Nienna
nodes.subtitle: The absent co-author of Hope
nodes.history: Nienna’s sacrifice and the Hallowing make Hope possible. Later language still names Nienna with Adelia and Elenia even after her death.
nodes.consequence: Adelia’s ascension cannot become solitary-hero mythology. The living result belongs partly to a person no longer present to claim it.
nodes.evidence: Nienna’s sacrifice and continuing association are established; some ritual mechanics remain incomplete.

nodes.title: Magnus Niriin
nodes.subtitle: Mercy answered with rupture
nodes.relation: A final restoration followed by betrayal
nodes.history: Adelia supports Magnus politically and later calls him her friend while using Divine Intervention to restore him at Hope. Minutes later he accepts Dumuzi’s gift and turns it against Hope.
nodes.consequence: Adelia’s trust becomes rupture and self-blame. Her guilt remains a consequence of the relationship, not proof that she caused the decision Magnus made after resurrection.
nodes.evidence: Resurrection, attack, and immediate response are directly observed; hidden preplanning remains unresolved.

nodes.title: Elenia
nodes.subtitle: Shared beginnings, divergent judgments
nodes.history: Adelia and Elenia help establish an early living foothold in Gael and share history around Hope. They later stand differently in the political judgment surrounding Magnus and Zarathis.
nodes.consequence: Their relationship resists reducing either woman to a single vote. Shared restoration does not guarantee permanent agreement about justice, mercy, or risk.
nodes.evidence: Gael work and later political divergence are established; the complete interpersonal aftermath remains open.

nodes.title: Pappy
nodes.subtitle: Protection after transformation
nodes.history: In the Rift era, Adelia senses danger and Gates Pappy away from an ambush. The rescue later becomes part of an out-of-character dispute over awareness and metagaming.
nodes.consequence: The in-world protection and governance dispute remain separate records. Neither layer is used to erase the other.
nodes.evidence: The rescue is established; disputed governance claims remain attributed to their own layer.

insights.label: Central bond
insights.note: Transformation remains answerable to the person who fears losing Adelia.

insights.label: Living legacy
insights.note: No single person authors renewal alone.

insights.label: Central question
insights.note: Adelia becomes increasingly inseparable from what she saves.

profile.personality: Adelia repeatedly answers grief with care rather than withdrawal. She can be fiercely protective and emotionally direct, yet her defining strength is her willingness to keep recognizing another person after death, transformation, or failure has changed what recognition costs.
profile.achievements: She carries Jiangshi from Gael’s shore, helps preserve the community through its early crises, and later gives herself to restore Hope after Magnus harms her. That final deed completes a long pattern: Adelia uses power to keep another life possible, even when the price becomes her own separate future.
profile.relationships: Her history is bound most closely to Jiangshi, Nienna, and Hope. Jiangshi’s loss and return make memory an active relationship; Nienna’s sacrifice gives Hope a life Adelia later protects; and Adelia’s choices repeatedly force the wider company to decide whether love means possession, rescue, remembrance, or letting another person continue differently.
